claims.statement: The slot correction was applied to the wrong feed and did not resolve the held-order condition
claims.limitation: Indicates our available corrective actions lack sufficient visibility into the multi-system carrier integration to fix the root cause unilaterally

claims.statement: The 186 stuck orders require carrier system intervention; our available mitigations have each failed, indicating the root cause is on the carrier integration side and requires carrier-side diagnostics and fixes
claims.limitation: Evidence strongly suggests carrier system issue, but specific failure point requires carrier-side investigation

next_action.rationale: Root cause established: carrier system integration failure (root_002) at approximately 05:58, causing 47-minute confirmation latency against 30-minute slot deadline. Three reversible mitigations attempted and failed: (1) revert allocation rules - ineffective, problem persists, (2) replay allocations - ineffective, slots already closed, (3) correct slot windows - ineffective, applied to wrong feed. The carrier system failure requires carrier-side investigation and remediation beyond our system visibility. Final status: 186 orders held, root cause identified as carrier_feed_lag, mitigation blocked without Carrier Operations intervention.
